paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range $74\mbox{--}110\,μ\mathrm{eV}/c^2$ with a Cryogenic Millimeter-Wave Receiver
notes: DOSUE-RR cryogenic mm-wave receiver search for dark photon dark matter via metal-plate conversion, 18-26.5 GHz (74-110 ueV). No signal found; 95% CL upper bound chi < (0.3-2.0)e-10 across the mass range. Paper provides only the range of the limit in text (full curve in Fig. 5, not tabulated), so data_points encode the conservative envelope value 2.0e-10 across the validity range; the strongest limit reached is 3e-11 at some frequencies. Assumes rho = 0.39 +/- 0.03 GeV/cm^3 and random DPDM polarization. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.65, 2))
